description: 只读分析 PikPak 重复/多版本媒体候选，适用于查重、重复文件、保留最新/最高清、find duplicates、compare versions。 名称候选不等于精确内容重复；先人工确认，按冻结报告逐 ID 批准，只打印命令，绝不自动删除。 Use when finding duplicate or multiple releases of the same movie or episode in PikPak: same title, different resolution, keep newest or highest quality. Name similarity is not proof of identical content; you approve each ID from a frozen report and commands are only printed, never executed.
